title: cirsium occidentale var. californicum
intro: Cirsium occidentale var. californicum, commonly known as California thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium occidentale var. californicum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and support the immune system. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
